caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass pitcher placed on a flat surface. The body of the pitcher is a light greenish hue with visible swirls and curves incorporated into the glass, adding decorative elements. The handle is thick and rounded, also formed from the same green-tinted glass and attached to the right side. The pitcher features an outwardly flared rim, which is adorned with several evenly spaced horizontal red lines that circle the top portion. The lower part of the pitcher is bulbous and narrows towards both the neck and the base, and a circular pedestal foot supports the vessel. The background is a plain, pale beige color, and the surface on which the pitcher rests has a subtle reflection of the object.
title: Blue Pitcher
